answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the vault checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The river graph is rebuilt each epoch, and as a result the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the pulse audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 3 times its size, so a group of 43 keys loses far more than 43 single identities would. That is 34 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
